f2.pair_summary: Both show the expected confirmations, display only applicable notes, retain the selected disposition after an empty submission, and clear the error after correction. ui-ad9dd9 gives the required rule and error stronger typographic emphasis and labels the saved text Recorded note. ui-fac496 adds a checkmark to confirmations and spells out that the rule applies to the current decision.
